A '''planet'''<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere AD">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> in [[the galaxy]] that was many [[parsec]]s away from [[Markez Moon]]. The [[planet]] had a [[Unidentified Rhydonium pipeline|pipeline]] that transported [[Rhydonium]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />  In [[3 BBY]]<ref name="GhormanDate">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates the events of "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" to [[3 BBY]].</ref> [[Wilmon Paak]], [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]] used a [[Rhydonium fuel pipe siphon|a piece of equipment]] to [[Rhydonium heist|steal]] an amount of Rhydonium from the pipeline.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet appeared, though it was not identified, in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
